opening.argument: The video presents Forsage as an Ethereum matrix program built around deposits, slot activation, and participant placement. Viewers are told to install a crypto wallet, deposit enough to register, and activate slots, with a recommendation to start with multiple slots. The earnings pitch is substantial: each slot allegedly generates income “unlimited times with no expiration,” while the structure directs placements through uplines and team spillover. The presentation also encourages viewers to contact the person who shared it to get started. Although it acknowledges that income is not guaranteed, it still promotes participation through repeated-earnings claims and concrete instructions for funding and upgrading matrix positions.
